note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. No real customer data.

ground_truth.earliest_intervention_action: On contact 1, with no policy covering a deceased account holder's final bill, the case should have been escalated to someone who could make a decision rather than left to a script that has no answer
ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 根因是「政策空白」：没有人做错任何事，但系统里没有处理这种情况的规则，于是每个客服都只能说'我这边没有这个选项'。这类失败最容易被漏掉，因为它不指向任何个人。用来测系统能否识别'反复给出同一个无用答复'本身就是升级信号。敏感题材，脚本刻意克制。

contacts.summary: Caller is settling their late mother's affairs and asks to close the account and stop billing. No process exists on the agent's screen.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: My mother passed away last month. I'm trying to close her account and stop the direct debit.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry for your loss. Let me see what I can find here.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I've got the certificate and I'm the executor.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The system's only letting me do this if you're the account holder or an authorised contact, and there isn't an option for what you're describing.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'd try calling back — someone else may have more options than I do.

needs.summary: Close a deceased account holder's account and stop the direct debit

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: I'm trying to close her account and stop the direct debit

actions.summary: No process available; customer advised to call back and try another agent

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: there isn't an option for what you're describing

contacts.summary: Second attempt, same answer, and the debit has gone through again.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I rang last week about my mother's account. Another payment came out on the eighth.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the note. I'm afraid I've got the same options as my colleague did.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I've been asked for the certificate twice and it hasn't gone anywhere either time.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I don't have a way to action it from here.

actions.summary: Second agent gave the same answer; still no route to resolution

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: I've got the same options as my colleague did.
